tasks.label: supabase: start
args: const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { const out = execSync('npx supabase status').toString(); if (out.includes('local development setup is not running') || out.includes('not running')) { console.log('Starting Supabase...'); execSync('yarn db:start', {stdio: 'inherit'}); } else { console.log('Supabase already running.'); } } catch (e) { console.log('Starting Supabase...'); execSync('yarn db:start', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }
